behaviour: Allow CardExtension to render without requiring a legacy Backstage AppContext or TranslationApi in ApiHolder.
rules: 1. In S1, import Progress as DefaultProgress alongside InfoCard from '@backstage/core-components' and import translationApiRef and useApiHolder alongside useTranslationRef from '@backstage/frontend-plugin-api'.

2. In S2 inside CardExtension, initialize let Progress = DefaultProgress and inside a try block call useApp().getComponents().Progress (with // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/rules-of-hooks) so missing AppContext falls back to DefaultProgress without throwing.
